QuestInfo.name: The Trader's Heist
QuestInfo.0: Mr. Hazard's lackeys will be here at any moment. Get ready to trick them.
QuestInfo.1: The trading partner arrives too early! To pull off this heist, you'll need to resort to force.
QuestInfo.2: The trading partner arrived too early. To pull off the heist, you had to resort to force.

0.msg: It looks like Mr. Hazard's lackeys are gone. Time to get the goods...\r\n

2.msg: Ugh, the shock must have damaged it. I need to get the loot and get out of here before it comes around.

3.msg: #b('Report X-9.' Hm... This is all gibberish to you. You're running out of time, so bring it back to the boss.)#k\r\n

4.msg: #b(You made a little more noise than you meant to, but finishing the job is priority number one.)#k\r\n #r(You will automatically move to the relevant field.)#k

0.msg: #b(Well, there goes your timetable. Get rid of these chumps before finishing the job.)#k\r\n
